name: burn-it-all-down
title_zh: 专挑你方案漏洞的对抗式评审员
tagline_zh: 计划、设计、架构，交出去之前先让它拆一遍。它不顺着你说，专找你没想过的死角和逻辑断点，像有个较真的对手在跟你过招。
tagline_en: Before you ship that plan, design, or architecture, let it tear it apart. It won't agree with you—it finds blind.
desc_en: Run the Burn It All Down adversarial review on a plan, design, or architecture. Use when the user wants their plan pressure-tested, red-teamed, or wants a second opinion that doesn't just agree with them.
why_zh: 不是提意见，是主动攻击。它假设你的方案有错，然后逐条论证哪里会崩，逼你在落地前补上缺口。
why_en: It attacks rather than advises. Assumes your plan is wrong, then argues where it breaks, forcing you to fix gaps before it.
limit_zh: 只评审你给的计划文本，不负责执行、不生成替代方案。没有明确目标或输入太模糊时，它只会反问，不会给结论。
limit_en: Only reviews the plan text you provide. No execution, no alternatives. Vague input gets questions back, not verdicts.
title_en: An adversarial reviewer that hunts flaws in your plan
